nodes.name: Load Prompt
nodes.notes: Reads system.md, schema.json, meta.json from /prompts/<prompt_dir> plus /prompts/model_params.json (Amendment 1).

nodes.name: Call Claude
nodes.notes: 30 s timeout; 2 retries 5 s apart (maxTries 3). Errors continue to Validate so the caller gets valid:false and alerts.

parameters.query:
INSERT INTO hotline.extraction_runs
  (conversation_id, attempt, prompt_version, model, output, is_valid,
   validation_errors, latency_ms, input_tokens, output_tokens)
VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5::jsonb, $6, $7::jsonb, $8, $9, $10)
RETURNING id, conversation_id, attempt, prompt_version, model, output, is_valid, validation_errors;

options.queryReplacement: ={{ [ $json.conversation_id, $json.attempt, $json.prompt_version, $json.model, $json.output === null || $json.output === undefined ? null : JSON.stringify($json.output), $json.is_valid === true, $json.validation_errors ? JSON.stringify($json.validation_errors) : null, $json.latency_ms, $json.input_tokens === undefined ? null : $json.input_tokens, $json.output_tokens === undefined ? null : $json.output_tokens ] }}

nodes.name: Retry?
nodes.notes: Attempt 1 produced bad output (schema errors, truncated or missing tool_use). API errors are not retried here.
